summary: Validated India (IN) support alongside Côte d'Ivoire (CI). Backend /api/config/countries returns [CI, LR, IN] with IN row exactly matching spec (INR/₹/en-IN/+91/Asia/Kolkata, min_order=199, delivery_fee=29, free_delivery_over=499, active=true, production_visible=true). CI row unchanged. GET /api/config/modules?country=IN returns all 6 modules (mart active + 5 coming_soon). Frontend selectors (/Sell-on-baked hero tagline, /partner/apply dropdown, /martbaked/sellers/apply step-1 dropdown) all show exactly [CI, IN] with no Liberia. Currency switch works via localStorage baked_country: IN → ₹499.00 free-delivery, ₹29.00 fee, ₹199.00 min, ₹0.00 cart, delivery ETA 20-30 min. CI → 15 000 CFA/500 CFA/3 000 CFA/0 CFA. baked_country=IN persists across /martbaked, /food, /express, /shop, /partner-portal/martbaked/login after reload. Google Places autocomplete works per-country: typing 'New Delhi' with IN active returns Delhi/India suggestions; 'Abidjan' with CI returns Ivorian suggestions. Address selector modal header updates to 'Serving India · ₹' vs 'Serving Côte d'Ivoire · CFA'. All acceptance criteria pass.

issues: 'Popular near you' pills still show LR-seeded zone names (Sinkor, Congo Town, Monrovia). Address selector 'Suggested' pills show CI-seeded (Cocody/Plateau/Marcory Abidjan) even when IN is active. Per review request this is a data-seeding gap (IN zones not seeded), NOT a country-support bug — report as note only.

action_items: Optional: Seed IN-specific neighborhood zones so 'Popular near you' and address-selector 'Suggested' pills show Indian cities (e.g., Connaught Place, Karol Bagh, Saket) when baked_country=IN. Non-blocking data gap.
critical_code_review_comments: IN country row seed values are exactly per spec and match the Sell-on-baked/partner-apply/seller-wizard UI options.
Google Places autocomplete correctly receives activeCountry.toLowerCase() via includedRegionCodes — verified live.
localStorage persistence via AppProvider works reliably across module routes.
